Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: How confident are you that you can react in time to danger on the bike?
questions.help: For example a car door opening suddenly, a vehicle cutting across you, or a junction where you can't see what's coming.

options.text: Not at all: I feel unprepared
A little: I know the risks, but they often catch me out
Fairly: I manage most, but some still worry me
Quite: I see most dangers coming and react well
Very: I feel ready for the usual dangers

questions.text: How good are the cycle lanes and paths on your usual route?
questions.help: Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and their signs and markings.

options.text: There are none, or almost none
There are some, but they stop and start or are badly made
They cover part of my route
They are good on most of my route
They are very good all along my route

questions.text: What gets in your way on your usual bike route?

options.text: Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane
People on foot or e-scooters in the cycle lane
Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path
No crossings or traffic lights for bikes
Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot leave the vehicle where I arrive
Stairs or steps on the route with no ramp or wheel channel

questions.text: When the road surface is bad, what do you do on the bike?
questions.help: For example potholes, cobblestones or uneven ground.

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I slow down or ride around it, on the same route
I take other roads, even if they are longer
It limits where and how often I can cycle

questions.text: Does heavy or fast traffic on your route change how you cycle?

options.text: I notice it, but it rarely changes my comfort or route
It sometimes makes cycling less pleasant
It often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
I change my route or time to avoid it

questions.text: When you cycle, do car drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do motorcycle or scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do bus drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, scooters) make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do taxi or ride-hailing drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do other cyclists make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do e-scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do poor visibility or limited sightlines make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, do crowding or conflicts with other road users make you feel unsafe?
When you cycle, does the absence of emergency services make you feel unsafe?

it.#How confident are you that you can reac: Quanto sei sicuro di riuscire a reagire in tempo a un pericolo in bici?
it.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Per esempio una portiera d'auto che si apre all'improvviso, un veicolo che ti taglia la strada o un incrocio dove non vedi cosa arriva.
it.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Poco: conosco i rischi, ma spesso mi colgono di sorpresa
it.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Abbastanza: me la cavo quasi sempre, ma alcuni pericoli mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Molto: vedo arrivare quasi tutti i pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Moltissimo: mi sento pronto ai pericoli più comuni
it.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Come sono le piste e i percorsi ciclabili sul tuo percorso abituale?
it.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Pensa a corsie e piste ciclabili, ai loro cartelli e alla segnaletica a terra.
it.#There are none, or almost none: Non ce ne sono, o quasi
it.#There are some, but they stop and start: Ce ne sono, ma si interrompono o sono fatte male
it.#They cover part of my route: Coprono una parte del mio percorso
it.#They are good on most of my route: Sono buone su gran parte del mio percorso
it.#They are very good all along my route: Sono molto buone su tutto il mio percorso
it.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Cosa ti ostacola sul tuo percorso abituale in bici?
it.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Auto o furgoni parcheggiati sulla corsia ciclabile
it.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Pedoni o monopattini elettrici sulla corsia ciclabile
it.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Bidoni, cartelli o pannelli sulla pista ciclabile
it.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Nessun attraversamento o semaforo per le bici
it.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Limiti dell'area dello sharing: non posso lasciare il mezzo dove arrivo
it.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Scale o gradini lungo il percorso senza rampa o canalina per le ruote
it.#When the road surface is bad, what do y: Quando il fondo stradale è brutto, cosa fai in bici?
it.#For example potholes, cobblestones or u: Per esempio buche, sampietrini o fondo irregolare.
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I slow down or ride around it, on the s: Rallento o lo evito restando sullo stesso percorso
it.#I take other roads, even if they are lo: Prendo altre strade, anche se sono più lunghe
it.#It limits where and how often I can cyc: Limita dove e quanto spesso posso andare in bici
it.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Il traffico intenso o veloce sul tuo percorso cambia il tuo modo di andare in bici?
it.#No, traffic doesn't bother me: No, il traffico non mi dà fastidio
it.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Me ne accorgo, ma raramente cambia la mia comodità o il percorso
it.#It sometimes makes cycling less pleasan: A volte rende meno piacevole andare in bici
it.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Spesso mi fa sentire stressato o poco sicuro
it.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Cambio percorso o orario per evitarlo
it.#When you cycle, do car drivers make you: Quando vai in bici, chi guida l’auto ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do motorcycle or scoote: Quando vai in bici, chi guida moto o scooter ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do bus drivers make you: Quando vai in bici, chi guida l’autobus ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do delivery vehicles (v: Quando vai in bici, i veicoli per le consegne (furgoni, cargo bike, scooter) ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do taxi or ride-hailing: Quando vai in bici, chi guida taxi o servizi di ride-hailing ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Quando vai in bici, altre persone in bici ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do e-scooter riders mak: Quando vai in bici, chi va in monopattino elettrico ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do pedestrians make you: Quando vai in bici, chi va a piedi ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do poor visibility or l: Quando vai in bici, la scarsa visibilità o la visuale limitata ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Quando vai in bici, i comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, do crowding or conflict: Quando vai in bici, l’affollamento o i conflitti con altri utenti della strada ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you cycle, does the absence of eme: Quando vai in bici, l’assenza di servizi di emergenza ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#Bicycle and a route between two points: Bicicletta e un percorso tra due punti
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Traffic, cycle lanes, road surfaces:
Traffico, piste ciclabili, fondo stradale e altri utenti della strada quando vai in bici.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

fr.#How confident are you that you can reac: Dans quelle mesure êtes-vous sûr de pouvoir réagir à temps à un danger à vélo ?
fr.#For example a car door opening suddenly: Par exemple une portière de voiture qui s'ouvre brusquement, un véhicule qui vous coupe la route ou un carrefour où vous ne voyez pas ce qui arrive.
fr.#Not at all: I feel unprepared: Pas du tout : je me sens mal préparé
fr.#A little: I know the risks, but they of: Un peu : je connais les risques, mais ils me surprennent souvent
fr.#Fairly: I manage most, but some still w: Assez : je gère la plupart, mais certains m'inquiètent encore
fr.#Quite: I see most dangers coming and re: Bien : je vois venir la plupart des dangers et je réagis bien
fr.#Very: I feel ready for the usual danger: Très bien : je me sens prêt face aux dangers habituels
fr.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Comment sont les pistes et les voies cyclables sur votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Pensez aux bandes et pistes cyclables, à leurs panneaux et à leur marquage.
fr.#There are none, or almost none: Il n'y en a pas, ou presque pas
fr.#There are some, but they stop and start: Il y en a, mais elles s'interrompent ou sont mal faites
fr.#They cover part of my route: Elles couvrent une partie de mon trajet
fr.#They are good on most of my route: Elles sont bonnes sur la plus grande partie de mon trajet
fr.#They are very good all along my route: Elles sont très bonnes sur tout mon trajet
fr.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Qu'est-ce qui vous gêne sur votre trajet habituel à vélo ?
fr.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Voitures ou camionnettes garées sur la piste cyclable
fr.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Piétons ou trottinettes électriques sur la piste cyclable
fr.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Poubelles, panneaux ou affiches sur la piste cyclable
fr.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Pas de passages ni de feux pour les vélos
fr.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Les limites de la zone de libre-service : je ne peux pas laisser le véhicule là où j'arrive
fr.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Des escaliers ou des marches sur le trajet sans rampe ni goulotte pour les roues
fr.#When the road surface is bad, what do y: Quand la chaussée est en mauvais état, que faites-vous à vélo ?
fr.#For example potholes, cobblestones or u: Par exemple des nids-de-poule, des pavés ou un sol irrégulier.
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I slow down or ride around it, on the s: Je ralentis ou je le contourne, sur le même trajet
fr.#I take other roads, even if they are lo: Je prends d'autres routes, même si elles sont plus longues
fr.#It limits where and how often I can cyc: Cela limite où et à quelle fréquence je peux rouler à vélo
fr.#Does heavy or fast traffic on your rout: Une circulation dense ou rapide sur votre trajet change-t-elle votre façon de faire du vélo ?
fr.#No, traffic doesn't bother me: Non, la circulation ne me gêne pas
fr.#I notice it, but it rarely changes my c: Je le remarque, mais cela change rarement mon confort ou mon trajet
fr.#It sometimes makes cycling less pleasan: Cela rend parfois le vélo moins agréable
fr.#It often makes me feel stressed or unsa: Cela me stresse ou me fait souvent sentir en danger
fr.#I change my route or time to avoid it: Je change d'itinéraire ou d'horaire pour l'éviter
fr.#When you cycle, do car drivers make you: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent une voiture ?
fr.#When you cycle, do motorcycle or scoote: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes à moto ou en scooter ?
fr.#When you cycle, do bus drivers make you: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un bus ?
fr.#When you cycle, do delivery vehicles (v: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des véhicules de livraison (fourgonnettes, vélos cargo, scooters) ?
fr.#When you cycle, do taxi or ride-hailing: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un taxi ou un VTC ?
fr.#When you cycle, do other cyclists make: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des autres cyclistes ?
fr.#When you cycle, do e-scooter riders mak: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#When you cycle, do pedestrians make you: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes à pied ?
fr.#When you cycle, do poor visibility or l: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause d’une mauvaise visibilité ou d’un champ de vision limité ?
fr.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent ?
fr.#When you cycle, do crowding or conflict: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de la foule ou de conflits avec d’autres personnes sur la route ?
fr.#When you cycle, does the absence of eme: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de l’absence de services d’urgence ?
fr.#Bicycle and a route between two points: Vélo et un itinéraire entre deux points
